title: Requirements Document for Unified Emergency Communication Platform (E-CoP)
summary: Master requirements specification for the Unified Emergency Communication Platform (E-CoP) covering functional, non-functional, operational, and data requirements across multi-channel emergency alerting in Ghana.
scope: Multi-channel alert dissemination (SMS, cell broadcast, TV/radio override, social media, digital signage)
Role-based access control and validation workflow
Multi-lingual TTS and accessibility (sign-language overlays, screen-reader)
Stakeholders: Government Agencies (MoCD, NADMO), Emergency Services, TNIO (telecom operators/ISPs), NGOs, International Partners, General Public
notes: Manifest-declared SPEC honored as authoritative. Content strongly supports SPEC classification: 22 functional requirements (FR1.1-FR13.2), 15 non-functional requirements (NFR1-NFR15), explicit performance SLOs (1-minute broadcast, 99.9% availability, 1000 concurrent users, millions of SMS/min), interoperability constraint (CAP protocol), data schema requirements, and acceptance criteria. Document Ref No: RQ_DOC_0. Acts as the master spec for the broader E-CoP, of which the Ghana National CAP Platform (ghana_cap_app.py) is a component implementation.
